newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia says tugrik fell 46 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia says tugrik fell 46 percent in 1996.

text.p: Mongolia's tugrik lost 46 percent of its value in 1996 to end the year at 693.51 to the U.S. dollar, the central Bank of Mongolia said on Thursday.
That compared with 473.62 tugriks to the dollar at end-1995.
Since the beginning of this year, the tugrik has lost 4.98 percent against the dollar according to central bank rates, it said. On Thursday, the rate was 728.08 tugriks to the dollar.
